blueprint.title: Flat Round Pipe Flange
blueprint.summary: A single flat annular flange plate lies with its faces horizontal and its axis vertical. It has a 40 mm central through bore and eight 8 mm bolt holes equally spaced on a 75 mm bolt circle.

parts.name: Flange blank
parts.role: main plate body carrying the bore and bolt holes
parts.shape: solid cylinder, axis vertical, later boolean-subtracted by the bore and bolt-hole cutters
parts.position: center at [0, 10, 0], bottom face at y=0

parts.name: Central bore cutter
parts.role: creates the 40 mm central through bore
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

parts.name: Bolt hole cutter 1
parts.role: creates the first 8 mm through bolt hole
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

parts.name: Bolt hole cutter 2
parts.role: creates the second 8 mm through bolt hole
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

parts.name: Bolt hole cutter 3
parts.role: creates the third 8 mm through bolt hole
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

parts.name: Bolt hole cutter 4
parts.role: creates the fourth 8 mm through bolt hole
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

parts.name: Bolt hole cutter 5
parts.role: creates the fifth 8 mm through bolt hole
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

parts.name: Bolt hole cutter 6
parts.role: creates the sixth 8 mm through bolt hole
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

parts.name: Bolt hole cutter 7
parts.role: creates the seventh 8 mm through bolt hole
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

parts.name: Bolt hole cutter 8
parts.role: creates the eighth 8 mm through bolt hole
parts.shape: subtractive cylinder, axis vertical, boolean difference from flange blank

callouts: Flange faces are horizontal; thickness is along Y from y=0 to y=20.
Outer diameter is 110 mm; central bore diameter is 40 mm.
Eight bolt holes are 8 mm diameter and equally spaced on a 75 mm pitch circle.
Bolt-hole cutters are 24 mm long to ensure clean through-booleans.

source.prompt: A flat round pipe flange lying flat (its faces horizontal): outer diameter 110 mm, thickness 20 mm, a central through bore of 40 mm, and 8 through bolt holes of 8 mm diameter equally spaced on a 75 mm pitch circle. Nothing else.
